entities.summary: Norka Latamblet Daudinot , also known as Norka Latamblet, is a former volleyball player from Cuba who played with the Cuban women's national volleyball team and won a gold medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. She was originally a setter and became an outside hitter.
